mapper.select: SELECT template_id as templateId, template_name as templateName, template_type as templateType, template_code as templateCode, description, html_content as htmlContent, config, bbzl, mr, sycx, czyxm, gxrq, status, create_time as createTime, update_time as updateTime FROM sys_report_template WHERE status = 1 ORDER BY template_id

SELECT template_id as templateId, template_name as templateName, template_type as templateType, template_code as templateCode, description, html_content as htmlContent, config, bbzl, mr, sycx, czyxm, gxrq, status, create_time as createTime, update_time as updateTime FROM sys_report_template WHERE status = 1 AND (template_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR template_code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR description LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')) ORDER BY template_id

SELECT template_id as templateId, template_name as templateName, template_type as templateType, template_code as templateCode, description, html_content as htmlContent, config, bbzl, mr, sycx, czyxm, gxrq, status, create_time as createTime, update_time as updateTime FROM sys_report_template WHERE template_id = #{templateId}

SELECT template_id as templateId, template_name as templateName, template_type as templateType, template_code as templateCode, description, html_content as htmlContent, config, bbzl, mr, sycx, czyxm, gxrq, status, create_time as createTime, update_time as updateTime FROM sys_report_template WHERE mr = 1 ORDER BY status DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_report_template ( template_name, template_type, template_code, description, config, mr, sycx, czyxm, gxrq, status ) VALUES ( #{templateName}, #{templateType}, #{templateCode}, #{description}, #{config}, #{mr}, #{sycx}, #{czyxm}, NOW(), 1 )
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_report_template SET template_name = #{templateName}, template_type = #{templateType}, template_code = #{templateCode}, description = #{description}, config = #{config}, mr = #{mr}, sycx = #{sycx}, czyxm = #{czyxm}, gxrq = NOW() WHERE template_id = #{templateId}
UPDATE sys_report_template SET mr = 0 WHERE template_id != #{templateId}
UPDATE sys_report_template SET mr = #{mr} WHERE template_id = #{templateId}
mapper.select: SELECT template_id as templateId, template_name as templateName, template_type as templateType, template_code as templateCode, description, html_content as htmlContent, config, bbzl, sb_djid as sbDjid, mr, sycx, czyxm, gxrq, status, create_time as createTime, update_time as updateTime FROM sys_report_template WHERE status = 1 AND JSON_CONTAINS(bbzl, CONCAT('"', #{bbzl}, '"')) ORDER BY mr DESC, status DESC LIMIT 1
